instruction: I need complete silence. Please mute the system audio entirely.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep 'Mute:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}'
